market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a well-established mid-table Premier League side with a quality squad and financial stability, making relegation very unlikely in any given season. Historical betting markets price their relegation risk at around 3–6% implied probability, far lower than the current 34.5% market price. Even accounting for interim struggles, a drop to the Championship in 2025–26 appears improbable.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023–24 and remain a comfortable mid-table team despite a mixed 2024–25.
Squad strength (Bowen, Kudus, Paquetá) and financial backing significantly exceed typical relegation candidates.
Mainstream bookmakers consistently assign West Ham relegation odds of 20/1 or longer, implying <5% probability.
sources_consulted: Betting odds comparison for West Ham relegation (e.g., pre-2024–25 season)
General knowledge of West Ham's squad and league position
